title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It should be starting soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, you've been saying that every minute for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I have?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It is about that time, so I guess you're not wrong.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you really caught us off guard when you said that two hours ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure she's just excited.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, it's Rin and Len's anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And they're streaming it!
Isn't it awesome?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It is since not everyone can go see them in person. This way, we can all celebrate together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting...!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Everyone, are you ready?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <How about everybody watching the stream? Are you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, of course, we are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, you should write a comment if you want them to know how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I know, but it's hard not to cheer since it feels like I'm right there with them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Let's get Kagamine Rin & Kagamine Len's Special Anniversary Show started♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They look like they're having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They really do. They seem so happy about being able to celebrate with their fans like this too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm so glad that we got to celebrate with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you mean that Christmas party?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wrong! It wasn't just any old Christmas party. It was a super special Christmas party with their anniversary party built in!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe... Super special...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, don't laugh so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry... No matter how many times you say it, I just can't help it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Rin and I spent so much time coming up with a good name for it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting to celebrate their anniversary during a Christmas party.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that caught me by surprise too. I get Len, but I didn't think Rin would prefer quality over quantity.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She actually said that we should just have “one big party”♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And Len seemed to nod in agreement then, so I'm sure he felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But he did mention something about not being used to being at the center of such a big party, so he might've been a little shy about having multiple.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I noticed that too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And combining three parties into one really helped us in terms of our budget.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It even let us turn the snacks we originally had as prizes for bingo into something much nicer.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Alright, everyone!
My part's about to start!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I hope you're all ready!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
The first half was Rin's part of the show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, they're doing two separate shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: These two may be no different from the Rin and Len we know from SEKAI, including the desire to have “one big party”.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't help but smile seeing them have so much fun performing like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I know that they're probably different from the Rin and Len we know from SEKAI, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see a part of them in these two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It just means that we've become that close with them, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You'll get to hear some classics, but my part of the show should feel a little different from Rin's part.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I've also thrown in some fun songs that should really make you smile and others that I'm sure you'll want to sing along to!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, it sounds like he really wants to go for more power and energy!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So try to keep up, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, we gotta be just as hyped as they are...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try cheering a little too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I might just join you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You too, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do I have to...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It is a show after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. Join us, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Yaaay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can do better than that, Shiho! Like this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehehe.
